script.onScreen: When someone is unkind to you. / One ayah. One lesson.

REFLECTION / The lesson / The ayah sets the good and the bad side by side and asks us to respond with what is better. The next ayah is honest about the cost: it takes patience. That makes it a goal to grow into, one response at a time.
LIVE IT TODAY / Answer a sharp message with a calm one · Greet first, even when it feels awkward · Make du'a for someone you find difficult
Respond with what is better. / Share it with someone who needs it

caption:
For the next time someone is short with you.

Fussilat 41:34, then the ayah after it (41:35): it takes patience.

sources.english: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend
But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good]
